ApgConfig.title: apg.yaml
ApgConfig.description: Declarative configuration (spec §14.1). Loaded by the node in file mode and by apgctl in database mode.

workspace.description: The workspace this document targets. Default: default.

plugins.description: Instances at global or workspace scope, or pointing at a service or route by name.

workspaces.description: Several workspaces in one document. File mode, or an admin caller (DEC-4).

CalloutRequest.title: CalloutRequest
CalloutRequest.description: What a node POSTs to the service of an http_callout plugin (spec §9.4).

query.description: The raw query string, without the question mark.

headers.description: Lower-cased names. Authorization and Cookie are left out unless include_headers lists them.

consumer.description: Null when no consumer was authenticated.

CalloutResponse.title: CalloutResponse
CalloutResponse.description: What the service of an http_callout plugin answers (spec §9.4). An empty object means: continue, change nothing.

action.description: continue forwards the request (or the response); respond answers the client with status, headers and body.

set_headers.description: With continue: headers to set on the forwarded request, or in the response phase on the response.

ref.description: A reference to another resource in the same workspace, by name or id.

metadata.description: Free-form. Never interpreted by the gateway. At most 16 KiB serialised.

hostname.description: Exact host or single-label wildcard (*.example.com). Lower case.

target.description: host:port, where host is an IP address or DNS name.

template.description: A string that may contain {{ variable }} placeholders (spec §9.5).

keySelector.description: What to key a hash, a limit or a split on.

secretValue.description: A secret-typed field never takes a bare string (spec §9.6).

errorResponses.description: Custom gateway error responses, keyed by error code (spec ERR-2).

envelope.description: Server-managed fields present on every stored resource.

PluginConfigAccessLog.title: access_log
PluginConfigAccessLog.description: Changes access logging for the requests in its scope (spec §9.4, §12.2). The access log never includes header values, so there is nothing to redact.

enabled.description: When false, requests in this scope are not logged.

sample_rate.description: The share of requests logged, from 0 to 1.

custom_fields.description: Field name to a template (spec §9.5). Written as one JSON object in the line's custom field.

PluginConfigAcl.title: acl
PluginConfigAcl.description: Allows or denies authenticated consumers by group. deny wins (spec §9.4).

allow.description: When not empty, only consumers in one of these groups pass.

PluginConfigBandwidthLimit.title: bandwidth_limit
PluginConfigBandwidthLimit.description: Byte-budget token bucket: admission before proxying, debit after the response (spec §9.4).

PluginConfigBasicAuth.title: basic_auth
PluginConfigBasicAuth.description: Authenticates a consumer by user name and password (spec §9.4, §10).

hide_credentials.description: Remove the Authorization header before the request is forwarded.

anonymous.description: A consumer name to run as when no credentials are presented.

PluginConfigCompression.title: compression
PluginConfigCompression.description: Compresses responses when the client accepts it. Responses that are already encoded are left alone (spec §9.4).

min_bytes.description: Responses declared smaller than this are not compressed.

content_types.description: Media types to compress. A family is written text/*.

PluginConfigCors.title: cors
PluginConfigCors.description: Cross-origin resource sharing. Preflight requests are answered by the gateway (spec §9.4).

origins.description: Exact origins, * for any, or one wildcard label such as https://*.example.com.

headers.description: Request headers allowed. Empty means: whatever the preflight asks for.

max_age.description: Seconds a browser may cache the preflight answer.

PluginConfigForwardAuth.title: forward_auth
PluginConfigForwardAuth.description: Asks another service whether a request may pass. A 2xx answer allows it; any other answer is given to the client (spec §9.4).

request_headers.description: Request headers sent to the service.

response_headers.description: Headers of the service's answer copied onto the forwarded request.

fail_open.description: When the service cannot be reached: true lets the request through, false refuses it.

cache_secs.description: How long an allowing answer is reused for the same cache_key_headers. 0 asks every time.

PluginConfigHttpCallout.title: http_callout
PluginConfigHttpCallout.description: Custom logic in any language: the node describes the request to a service (callout-request.json) and acts on its answer (callout-response.json) (spec §9.4).

fail_open.description: When the service cannot be asked: true carries on as if it had said continue, false answers 500.

include_headers.description: Headers shown to the service. Empty means all except Authorization and Cookie.

include_body_bytes.description: How much of the request body to show the service.

secret.description: Signs each call: X-Apg-Signature: t=<unix>,v1=<hmac-sha256 of "<t>.<body>">.

PluginConfigIpRestriction.title: ip_restriction
PluginConfigIpRestriction.description: Allows or denies requests by client address. deny wins (spec §9.4).

allow.description: CIDR blocks or addresses. When not empty, anything outside is denied.

PluginConfigJwtAuth.title: jwt_auth
PluginConfigJwtAuth.description: Verifies a JSON Web Token and optionally maps it to a consumer (spec §9.4).

issuer.description: The iss claim must equal this.

audiences.description: When not empty, the aud claim must contain one of these.

jwks_url.description: Where the signing keys are published.

jwks.description: Signing keys inline, as a JSON Web Key Set.

leeway_secs.description: Clock difference tolerated for exp and nbf.

required.description: When false, a request with no token passes unauthenticated.

consumer_claim.description: A claim whose value must equal a consumer custom_id.

claims_to_headers.description: Claim name to the request header that carries it upstream.

anonymous.description: A consumer name to run as when no token is presented.

PluginConfigKeyAuth.title: key_auth
PluginConfigKeyAuth.description: Authenticates a consumer by an API key (spec §9.4, §10).

key_names.description: Header and query parameter names the key may arrive in.

hide_credentials.description: Remove the key before the request is forwarded.

anonymous.description: A consumer name to run as when no key is presented.

PluginConfigMtlsAuth.title: mtls_auth
PluginConfigMtlsAuth.description: Authenticates a consumer by client certificate. Revocation is not checked (spec §9.4).

ca_certificates.description: CA certificates a client's chain must lead to, by name or id.

consumer_by.description: Which value of the certificate is matched against mtls credentials. fingerprint is the SHA-256 of the certificate, lower-case hex.

skip_consumer_lookup.description: Accept any certificate from a trusted CA without naming a consumer.

anonymous.description: A consumer name to run as when no certificate is presented.

PluginConfigQuota.title: quota
PluginConfigQuota.description: A request allowance per calendar hour, day or month, UTC (spec §9.4). Counted per node.

fail_open.description: On a store error, let the request through.

per_second.description: Sustained rate. Fractions are allowed: 0.5 is 30 per minute.

fail_open.description: On a Redis error, fall back to the local bucket.

PluginConfigRedirect.title: redirect
PluginConfigRedirect.description: Answers with a redirect. Parts left out are taken from the request (spec §9.4).

PluginConfigRequestSizeLimit.title: request_size_limit
PluginConfigRequestSizeLimit.description: Refuses request bodies over a size (spec §9.4).

PluginConfigRequestTransformer.title: request_transformer
PluginConfigRequestTransformer.description: Changes headers, query parameters and JSON body fields of the forwarded request. Operations run in the order rename, remove, set, add. Values are templates (spec §9.4, §9.5).

max_body_bytes.description: A larger body passes through unchanged.

set.description: Replace the value, or create it.

add.description: Add another value, keeping what is there.

set.description: JSON Pointer to the value to put there. A string value is a template.

PluginConfigResponseCache.title: response_cache
PluginConfigResponseCache.description: Caches responses in memory, per node. Adds X-Apg-Cache: HIT, MISS or BYPASS (spec §9.4).

ttl_secs.description: How long a response is kept when its Cache-Control does not say.

respect_cache_control.description: Honour no-store, private, no-cache, max-age and s-maxage, and never store a response that sets a cookie.

vary_headers.description: Request headers whose values are part of the cache key.

max_object_bytes.description: A larger response is not stored.

cache_authenticated.description: Cache for authenticated callers too, each consumer apart.

PluginConfigResponseTransformer.title: response_transformer
PluginConfigResponseTransformer.description: Changes headers and JSON body fields of the upstream's response. Operations run in the order rename, remove, set, add. Values are templates (spec §9.4, §9.5).

max_body_bytes.description: A larger body passes through unchanged.

PluginConfigStaticResponse.title: static_response
PluginConfigStaticResponse.description: Answers without an upstream: maintenance pages and mocks (spec §9.4).

CaCertificate.title: CaCertificate
CaCertificate.description: A PEM bundle used to verify upstreams or client certificates (spec §4.4).

Certificate.title: Certificate
Certificate.description: A TLS certificate and its private key (spec §4.4). The key is write-only.

cert_pem.description: Leaf certificate followed by its chain.

cert_file.description: File mode only: path the node reads the certificate from.

key_file.description: File mode only: path the node reads the key from.

oneOf.description: key_pem may be omitted only when updating a certificate whose cert_pem is unchanged.

Consumer.title: Consumer
Consumer.description: An identified caller of an API (spec §10).

custom_id.description: External identity, for example a JWT sub. Unique per workspace.

Credential.title: Credential
Credential.description: A credential held by a consumer (spec §10). Secrets are write-only.

key.description: Write-only. Generated when omitted (Admin API only).

Domain.title: Domain
Domain.description: A hostname owned by exactly one workspace, with a TLS policy (spec §4.3).

certificate.description: Certificate name or id. Required when mode is manual.

Flag.title: Flag
Flag.description: A global runtime switch (spec §4.8). An unknown flag reads as enabled.

Plugin.title: Plugin
Plugin.description: A plugin instance attached at a scope (spec §9.1). `config` is validated separately against schemas/plugins/<type>.json.

scope_ref.description: Service or route name or id. Required for those scopes.

nested.description: A plugin written under a route or service in apg.yaml; the scope is implied.

Route.title: Route
Route.description: Match predicates that send a request to a service (spec §4.6, §6.3).

plugins.description: Declarative config only: plugin instances attached to this route.

Service.title: Service
Service.description: A named upstream: backends plus load-balancing, health, timeout and retry policy (spec §4.5, §7).

shared.description: System workspace only: routes in any workspace may reference this service.

egress_restricted.description: When true the node refuses to connect this service to loopback, link-local and private addresses unless APG_BACKEND_ALLOW_CIDRS covers them (spec SEC-4). The admin sets it from the role of whoever wrote the service; a value sent to the Admin API is ignored.

host_header.description: preserve, backend, or a literal Host value.

plugins.description: Declarative config only: plugin instances attached to this service.

Settings.title: Settings
Settings.description: Global routing configuration that is not a resource (spec §4.8). Each property is one Setting.

workspace_base_domains.description: Every workspace implicitly owns {slug}.{domain} for each entry (DOM-2).

workspace_resolvers.description: How a request matched by a system route is attributed to a workspace (spec §6.4).

workspace_plugin_types.description: Plugin types a non-admin role may create (PL-7). Default: every type except wasm.

WasmModule.title: WasmModule
WasmModule.description: A WebAssembly component referenced by wasm plugin instances (spec §4.7). Bytes are uploaded separately.

id.description: May be supplied at creation so an embedding platform can use its own tenant id.

slug.description: DNS label used for base-domain hosts.
